description:
Fast, fully offline image description and an accessible overlay for windows NVDA cannot read. Everything runs on your own computer. Images are never sent to the internet.
NVDA+Alt+A: describe the current element
NVDA+Alt+W: describe the current window
NVDA+Alt+F: describe the whole screen
NVDA+Alt+D: describe the clipboard image
NVDA+Alt+E: find something on screen, like the Save button, and click it
On a photo message in a chat app, or an image file in File Explorer, NVDA+Alt+A describes the photo itself.
Press twice for a detailed description in a window, where you can ask questions about the image.
NVDA+Alt+O: the overlay, a list of a window's texts and icons; Enter clicks an item
NVDA+Alt+G: automatic descriptions of images without a label, on or off
NVDA+Alt+B: names for buttons without a name, on or off
NVDA+Alt+N: give your own name to a button or overlay item
NVDA+Alt+Shift+A: describe the newest picture in a chat
NVDA+Alt+P: how far a description is; NVDA+Alt+X: stop it
NVDA+Alt+U: pointer mode, the mouse from the keyboard; NVDA+Alt+Q: controller mode
NVDA+Alt+Y: take the help offered where a window tells NVDA little
changelog:
* New: pointer mode (NVDA+Alt+U) works the mouse from the keyboard and says what is under the pointer. Space holds the button for dragging, H hovers and reads what appears, T gives touch and pen gestures, G is a game mouse for games that turn the view with the mouse.
* New: controller mode (NVDA+Alt+Q, or View and Menu held together): a game controller works the mouse pointer.
* New: NVDA+Alt+E finds something on screen, like the Save button, says roughly where it is, and can click it or move the mouse there.
* New: NVDA+Alt+Shift+A describes the newest picture in a chat, leaving out emoji and profile pictures.
* New: NVDA+Alt+X stops a description or an answer; NVDA+Alt+P says how far it is.
* New: actions in the overlay (A) and in find on screen (More): hover, drag and drop, press and hold, set a drawn knob or slider to a number, work it with the arrow keys, write on a scanned form, touch and pen.
* Overlay: fields and errors marked in red (R), colour choices named by measured colour, picture puzzles of human checks numbered and described, the most useful item (U), tables (T, Control+Alt+arrows) and "more below" for areas that scroll.
* Overlay: an icon or thumbnail beside a label is no longer a separate item, and NVDA's mouse tracking no longer talks over the overlay.
* Detailed window: Read all text, Describe people, Describe colours, Where is..., and Save (Control+S). Questions in several parts are answered part by part; colours are measured from the pixels.
* New: help offered where a window, dialog or control tells NVDA little (NVDA+Alt+Y).
* New: memories ("remember that ..."), your own instructions, VisionMate's own voice, and a portable copy for a flash drive or another computer.
* Faster: pressing again on a screen that barely changed starts speaking in under a second; background work gets out of the way sooner.
* More reliable: the engine restarts by itself if it stops; a dropped download resumes; low disk space is reported first.
* Settings are in groups, with Reset to defaults.
